方法：分析评述近年来国内外相关文献资料。结果：两种药物可以在药剂学、药物动力学和药效学方面发生相互作用从而使药效加强或减弱，或（和）不良反应减弱或增强。结论：医生和药师应熟知药物相互作用，以增加药物疗效，降低药品不良反应发生，促进合理用药。Drug Interaction and Primary Exploration of Rational use of Drugs in Clinical Application
REN Xia-yang, ZHAO Zhi-gang\*Department of pharmacy, Beijing Tiantan Hospital Affiliated to Capital Medical University, Beijing 100050 Abstract: Objective: To review the mechanism and classification of drug interaction, and the relationship with safe and rational use of drugs in clinical application. Methods: Analysis and comments were made on the literatures at home and abroad in recent years. Results: Two drugs can be interacted in the aspects of pharmaceutics, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, so that drug effects and side effects can be enhanced or weakened.Conclusions: Clinicians and pharmacists should know very well about these interactions to increase drug efficacy and reduce the occurrence of adverse drug reactions, and improve the rational use of drugs.药物相互作用是指病人同时或在一定时间内先后使用（相同或不同途径）两种或两种以上药物所出现的复合效应。
source: 常见药物相互作用与临床合理用药初探_任夏洋.pdf
